text: You see a shopkeeper.
source_text: You see a shopkeeper.

text: The Holy Flame does not appreciate thieves and scoundrels in his house of worship.  You will be punished!
source_text:
The Holy Flame does not appreciate thieves and scoundrels in his
 house of worship.  You will be punished!

text: Hng!
source_text: Hng!

text: I wasn't stealing from you, honest!
source_text: I wasn't stealing from you, honest!

text: Why don't you tell the Holy Flame when you see him after your 'punishment.'
source_text: Why don't you tell the Holy Flame when you see him after your 'punishment.'

text: I care not for your lies, neither shall the Master.
source_text: I care not for your lies, neither shall the Master.

text: I'm sorry the shop is closed.
source_text: I'm sorry the shop is closed.

text: Nugga.
source_text: Nugga.

text: Thanks for nothing.
source_text: Thanks for nothing.

text: Why is that?
source_text: Why is that?

text: Don't mention it.
source_text: Don't mention it.

text: The Children do not have to deal with your kind.  And you've been causing us a serious problem. I would like you to go away before I have to call in reinforcements.
source_text:
The Children do not have to deal with your kind.  And you've been
 causing us a serious problem. I would like you to go away before I
 have to call in reinforcements.

text: You don't have to do that. I'm your friend.
source_text: You don't have to do that. I'm your friend.

text: Whatever.
source_text: Whatever.

text: I refuse to deal with those that use weapons to make demands.  We Children have grown beyond the simple use of guns and weapons.
source_text:
I refuse to deal with those that use weapons to make demands.  We
 Children have grown beyond the simple use of guns and weapons.

text: Gun control fascist nut!
source_text: Gun control fascist nut!

text: Let me holster it and we can barter in peace.
source_text: Let me holster it and we can barter in peace.

text: Good, I'd like that. I'd be happy to do business with you.
source_text: Good, I'd like that. I'd be happy to do business with you.

text: Greetings, my fellow Child.  How can I help you?
source_text: Greetings, my fellow Child.  How can I help you?

text: Lugga!?
source_text: Lugga!?

text: What do you have to trade?
source_text: What do you have to trade?

text: Thanks. See you later, alligator.
source_text: Thanks. See you later, alligator.

text: I'm sorry. Perhaps we can just make a deal.
source_text: I'm sorry. Perhaps we can just make a deal.

text: Brye!
source_text: Brye!

text: After a while, crocodile. I can't believe I just said that.
source_text: After a while, crocodile. I can't believe I just said that.

text: Greetings! How can I help you? I do hope that you will take a moment to realize the significance of any future decisions you might make in regards to your soul...
source_text:
Greetings! How can I help you? I do hope that you will take a moment
 to realize the significance of any future decisions you might make in
 regards to your soul...

text: Baarta!
source_text: Baarta!

text: What do you have to trade?
source_text: What do you have to trade?

text: Where can I get one of those fancy robes of yours...
source_text: Where can I get one of those fancy robes of yours...

text: Only trusted members of the Cathedral are allowed to wear the holy purple.
source_text: Only trusted members of the Cathedral are allowed to wear the holy purple.

text: I guess that answers my question, thanks!
source_text: I guess that answers my question, thanks!

text: Stuck up fool. I guess I will have to take yours!
source_text: Stuck up fool. I guess I will have to take yours!

text: Oh, well. What do you have to trade?
source_text: Oh, well. What do you have to trade?

text: Oh, stuff to pander to the rubes who walk in the door.  Nothing too special. Go ahead, take a look.
source_text:
Oh, stuff to pander to the rubes who walk in the door.  Nothing too special.
 Go ahead, take a look.

text: Thanks, see you later.
source_text: Thanks, see you later.

text: We have all sorts of special items to remember your trip to the Cathedral. These memories can't be bought cheaply, you understand.
source_text:
We have all sorts of special items to remember your trip to the Cathedral.
 These memories can't be bought cheaply, you understand.

text: Thanks...
source_text: Thanks...

text: You're welcome. Have pleasant days for the rest of your life.
